findings.message: CloudProjectSyncPort is properly defined with sync_project(project) and is_available() methods, providing clean abstraction for cloud sync operations.
InMemoryCloudProjectSync adapter provides deterministic non-network implementation for contract testing, enabling offline validation of sync behavior.

OfflineAutosaveService schedules autosave snapshots at configurable 30-second interval (DEFAULT_AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL_MSEC = 30000). Uses bounded queue (MAX_PENDING_SNAPSHOTS = 8) to prevent unbounded memory growth.
Non-blocking I/O design: maybe_schedule() only enqueues cloned snapshots, process_pending() performs local save when interaction_active is false, keeping I/O off the active interaction path.

Cloud sync is optional and gated by explicit consent. Sync only occurs when cloud adapter exists and is_available() returns true, AND explicit consent exists (cloud_sync or parental_control_cloud_sync_consent) on candidate profiles.
Snapshot isolation is correct: queued snapshots are cloned and do not mutate with later project edits, ensuring consistency.

Contract test coverage is comprehensive. run_contract_tests.sh passes with Contracts: 54  Checks: 696  Failed contracts: 0. New passing contracts: CloudProjectSyncPort (4 checks), InMemoryCloudProjectSyncAdapter (10 checks), OfflineAutosaveService (14 checks).
Contracts documentation and context map updated to reflect new adapter. tests/contracts/README.md and src/domain/CONTEXT_MAP.md both updated.

acceptance_criteria.autosave_30s_non_blocking: PASS - Autosave runs every 30 seconds via maybe_schedule() with deferred I/O in process_pending(), non-blocking
acceptance_criteria.cloud_sync_optional_consent: PASS - Cloud sync is optional dependency, requires explicit consent via IdentityConsentPort checks before sync

checklist.hexagonal_architecture: PASS - CloudProjectSyncPort (outbound port), InMemoryCloudProjectSync (adapter), OfflineAutosaveService (application service) follow clean separation
checklist.memory_safety: PASS - Bounded queue (MAX_PENDING_SNAPSHOTS = 8) prevents unbounded memory growth
checklist.snapshot_isolation: PASS - Queued snapshots are cloned and isolated from later project edits
checklist.test_coverage: PASS - All 54 contracts pass with 696 checks, including 3 new contracts specific to TASK-035

summary: APPROVE. TASK-035 implementation is complete and production-ready. Offline autosave with non-blocking I/O and optional consent-gated cloud sync are fully implemented. All acceptance criteria are met: 30-second interval autosave without blocking, cloud sync optional with explicit parent consent. All tests pass and hexagonal architecture boundaries are respected.
